{{Quote|It commemorates Gavail Kespan. He died defending the capital during the Wanderers' Siege.|Nadia Grell, on the Annex of Kespan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Gavail Kespan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] defending the [[Sarkhai's capital city|capital city]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] during the [[Wanderers' Siege]]. The [[Annex of Kespan]] was built to commemorate his sacrifice.
